newsitem.title: USA: Grace to sell polymers business for $147 mln.
newsitem.headline: Grace to sell polymers business for $147 mln.

text.p: W. R. Grace & Co said Monday it had entered into an agreement to sell its specialty polymers business for $147 million cash to National Starch and Chemical Co.
Grace's specialty polymers business, with manufacturing locations in the United States, Belgium and Japan, had 1996 sales of $73 million.

The business is a global producer of advanced technology adhesives, coatings, encapsulants and polymer thick films, which are used for circuit and component assembly, and medical and industrial assembly.
The business also produces photopolymers for use in the production of printed circuit boards. It employs about 325 people.

National Starch, based in Bridgewater, N.J., is a worldwide manufacturer of adhesives, resins, specialty chemicals, electronic materials and specialty industrial and food starches. Its annual sales are $2.5 billion.
Grace is a global supplier of packaging and specialty chemicals. Its annual sales are $3.5 billion.
